data.name: 时装工坊
data.detailed_description:
多种编辑模式

Players can use various editing modes such as cutting, lace, ornaments, cloth, stickers, patterns, colors, etc. to make clothes. Each piece of clothes is unique. Players can add or reduce cloth to the basic template at will and change the appearance of clothes. Every dress is your exclusive work.


About the Game

This is an immersive creative game that combines fashion design and simulation management. You will play an independent fashion designer from scratch, run your own tailor shop in the bustling fashion capital, start from a small attic studio, and gradually build your own fashion empire.

Here, you can design clothes from scratch, then sell them, get more production materials, and then make more beautiful clothes.

An ordinary clothing template can be changed into various styles or anything you imagine.

After the design is completed, you can freely match scenes, special effects and actions to take a picture of your own work.

It's not just a simulated business game. More like a fashion design studio that belongs to you.
